annotation_summary: Functional missense substitution in CC-NBS-LRR C-terminal domain conferring broad-spectrum durable resistance against Tomato Mosaic Virus (ToMV) and Tobacco Mosaic Virus (TMV).
Wild-type reference allele lacking ToMV movement protein recognition capability, rendering the plant susceptible to mosaic virus infections.
Introgression polymorphism in RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (SlRDR1) that hyperactivates transcriptional gene silencing of begomovirus/geminivirus genomes.
NBS-LRR resistance allele recognizing the secreted Avr2 protein of Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. lycopersici race 2.
Premature truncation mutation in the extracellular LRR receptor Ve1 causing loss of Verticillium Ave1 effector recognition.
Intact full-length Ve1 eLRR receptor providing cell surface immune perception against Verticillium dahliae race 1.
Autophosphorylation activation domain variant in Pto Ser/Thr kinase enabling physical complex formation with AvrPto and Prf-mediated signaling.
Solanum pimpinellifolium introgressed CC-NBS-LRR allele conferring strong broad-spectrum resistance to Phytophthora infestans (Late Blight).
Solanum peruvianum introgression NBS-LRR locus conferring dominant resistance against Tomato Spotted Wilt Virus (TSWV).
Receptor-like transmembrane protein with extracellular LRRs conferring resistance to Cladosporium fulvum (Passalora fulva) leaf mold.
Loss-of-function nonsense mutation in susceptibility gene SlMlo1 conferring recessive broad-spectrum resistance to powdery mildew (Oidium neolycopersici).
Dual resistance NBS-LRR gene providing protective immunity against Root-Knot Nematodes (Meloidogyne spp.) and Potato Aphids (Macrosiphum euphorbiae).
Uniform ripening (u) allele in GLK2 transcription factor producing evenly colored fruit with lower chloroplast development and reduced sugar content.
